## Pull request overview

This PR implements 9 phases of the Console Development Roadmap, achieving comprehensive NavigationConfig compliance across all view plugins, integrating metadata API expansion, expression engine wiring, RBAC, real-time updates, action system, and offline/PWA support.

**Changes:**
- Extended NavigationConfig support to 5 additional view plugins (kanban, calendar, gantt, map, timeline) using the `useNavigationOverlay` + `NavigationOverlay` pattern established in grid/list
- Added `getPage()` method to DataSource interface with implementation in ObjectStackAdapter for server-driven page layouts
- Integrated expression evaluator for CRUD dialog field visibility, toolbar action rendering, RBAC permission gates for navigation and create button, real-time auto-refresh via WebSocket subscriptions, and offline indicator in AppHeader

Type cast to 'any' is used to access the navigation property, which isn't defined in the schema interfaces for these plugins (TimelineSchema, CalendarSchema, GanttSchema, KanbanSchema, MapSchema). Consider updating the type definitions to include the optional navigation property like ObjectGridSchema does, or create a common base interface that includes navigation for all view plugins. This would improve type safety and IDE autocomplete support.

The onClick handler attached to the drag wrapper may conflict with drag-and-drop interactions. When a user attempts to drag a card, the click event could fire instead, or vice versa. Consider adding event.stopPropagation() or moving the onClick to the Card component itself (outside the drag listeners), or using a threshold-based approach where clicks only fire if no drag movement occurred.
```suggestion
    <div ref={setNodeRef} style={style} {...attributes} {...listeners} role="listitem" aria-label={card.title}>
      <Card
        className="mb-2 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing border-border bg-card/60 hover:border-primary/40 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/10 transition-all duration-300 group touch-manipulation"
        onClick={() => onCardClick?.(card)}
      >
```

The real-time subscription is created without providing a WebSocket URL. The useRealtimeSubscription hook requires a 'url' parameter to connect to the WebSocket server. Without it, the hook will set an error state ('WebSocket URL is required') and the subscription won't function. You should either provide the WebSocket URL from configuration or handle the case where real-time is not configured (e.g., by conditionally calling the hook).
